summary: Regression analysis is used to model the relationship between a response variable and one or more predictor variables. Estimation is a key factor used in regression analysis. title: Runge-Kutta Method in Python and MATLAB
summary: Through this in-depth course, we delve into the theory behind the Runge-Kutta Method (RK4), which serves as a numerical approach for solving ordinary differential equations (ODEs). To illustrate the method's application, we simulate and solve the well-established Lotka-Volterra model, commonly called the Predator-Prey model, utilizing RK4.
